10637759898.description:
❗How to play Guess the Person 
Take turns asking questions. "Is it a man?" "Do they have brown hair?" You only press buttons. No typing.
Your opponent answers Yes or No. Then you look at THEIR board and flip down every face that cannot be it.
When one face is left on their board, guess it. The match does not end there. Your opponent gets time to make their guess too. Then both guesses are shown at the same time. You can BOTH be right.

👑 You get crowns when you win. Use crowns to buy win emotes - a dance your character does on the win screen, so the other player sees it.
🤖 Nobody to play with? Press Play Alone. A bot sits in the other seat and plays a real match.
⭐ How to play

1. Sit on a chair in the lobby
2. Pick your secret face
3. Ask, answer, flip
4. Guess their face before they guess yours
10637759898.name: [2 Player] Guess The Person

10768943703.description:
Rally with a Friend! Early access is here!

Team up with a friend and take on narrow roads, blind corners and jumps. One player drives while the copilot calls turns using a handheld map. Hold onto it, or drop it into the cabin.

Explore Finland, Sweden, Utah and Japan, with two stages per country and day or night driving (way more to come 👀). Face fog, rain, snow, dirty windshields and headlights that can cut out. (also a lot more features are planned)

Meet in the pits (hub), form a party and enter your own private stage. Optional passes unlock Japan Touge and more cars, including the Ponda, WRC car and four-seat XRW for up to four players.

Finish clean stages to earn REP, set personal bests and climb the leaderboards. Hard crashes can cause blackouts and cost REP. Solo driving is available with a dashboard map, but solo times are not ranked.

Are you here to mess around with friends or chase the fastest time?

Original Credits to Left! Left! LEFT! on Steam. GO PLAY IT!

10768944292.description:
🦖 Welcome to Prehistoric Farm 🦖

Dig up the past and bring it back to life! Sail across wild islands, unearth ancient fossils, and turn them into eggs at Dr. Ivy's DNA Lab. Hatch your very own dinosaurs, raise them from tiny Newborns into huge Elders, and ride them across your ranch!

[How To Play]
▪ Grab your shovel and hold down on a dig site. Let go when the meter is in the green for a better find!
▪ Collect a full set of fossils and bring them to Dr. Ivy to grow an egg
▪ Warm your egg in the incubator and watch it hatch
▪ Keep your dino's belly over half full so it keeps growing
▪ Once it's grown, hop on and ride your partner dino around the islands!

[Explore]
▪ Buy bigger boats and sail to new fossil islands
▪ Fish the open sea and dive for rare catches
▪ Sneak into the Sunken Grotto to steal sea reptile eggs
▪ Team up with other players to take down the giant Mosasaurus with spears!

Works on PC, mobile and console.

Nominee for "Sleeper Hit" in the 7th Annual Bloxy Awards. 

Rogue Lineage is a fantasy game with roguelike elements. The game revolves around a permadeath mechanic, where each of your characters will have but a few lives before they die forever. R - reload (hold to rotate in build mode) 
Q - cycle sights 
V - cycle firing mode 
T - toggle/cycle all attachment modes 
F - interact 
`/~ - free mouse/manual attachment mode toggle (open buildable menu in build mode) 
B - enter build mode

The board is divided into tiles, with mines randomly distributed.
